answer: One concrete defense is bonded proof-of-work-per-identity: every agent must stake a refundable deposit to mint an identity, so spinning up a swarm of fakes carries real cost. An attacker's return sinks to its nadir while honest participation climbs toward the summit of reputation. Like the fixed form of a sonnet, the staking rule is rigid and uniform for all, letting peers slash misbehaving deposits and making sybil armies economically ruinous rather than free.
